description: Trigger: cli/audit.rs uses .expect("re-serialization must not fail") inside the main audit log export loop when re-serializing JSON events loaded from the database. If any stored event_json row contains data that fails serde_json re-serialization after parsing (e.g. due to a schema change or database corruption), the expect panics. Bad behavior: the entire audit export CLI command panics, aborting mid-stream with a non-zero exit code and no partial output, making post-incident forensics harder.
title: cli/audit.rs panics on re-serialization failure inside hot export loop
